camel_example: aliyun ims CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --PredefinedScopes aliuid_profile --SecretRequired true --DisplayName myapp --RedirectUris 'https://www.example.com' --AccessTokenValidity 3600 --IsMultiTenant false --RefreshTokenValidity 2592000 --ProtocolVersion '2.0' --AppType WebApp --RequiredScopes aliuid --AppName myapp
kebab_example: aliyun ims create-application --display-name myapp --app-type WebApp --redirect-uris https://www.example.com --secret-required true --access-token-validity 3600 --refresh-token-validity 2592000 --predefined-scopes aliuid_profile --required-scopes aliuid --is-multi-tenant false --app-name myapp --protocol-version 2.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the application.

It can be up to 24 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
应用的显示名称。

最大长度为24个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

- WebApp: a web application that is based on browser interaction.

- NativeApp: a native application that runs on an operating system, such as a desktop or mobile operating system.

- ServerApp: an application that directly accesses Alibaba Cloud services without user logon. Currently, only applications that use the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol for user synchronization are supported
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型。取值：

- WebApp：指基于浏览器交互的网络应用。 
- NativeApp：指操作系统中运行的本地应用，主要为运行在桌面操作系统或移动操作系统中的应用。 
- ServerApp：指直接访问阿里云服务，而无需依赖用户登录的应用，目前仅支持基于SCIM协议的用户同步应用
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.help_en:
The redirect URL of the application.

To specify multiple URLs, separate them with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
回调地址。

输入多个时，以英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: redirect_uris

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a secret is required. Valid values:

- true

- false

> * For applications of the WebApp and ServerApp types, this parameter is required and is always set to true.

- For applications of the NativeApp type, you can set this parameter to true or false. If not specified, the default value is false. Since native applications are public clients and cannot reliably protect secrets, we recommend keeping this false unless a secret is strictly required. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要应用密钥。取值：

- true
- false

> - 对于WebApp和ServerApp类型的应用，该值会被强制设置为true，不支持修改。
- 对于NativeApp类型的应用，可以设置为true或false，如不设置，默认为false。由于此类应用往往运行在非可信环境，无法有效保护应用密钥，因此建议您如无明确需要，不要设置为true。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.name: secret_required

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the access token.

Valid values: 900 to 10800. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh:
访问令牌有效期。

取值范围：900~10800。单位：秒。

默认值：3600
parameters.name: access_token_validity

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the refresh token.

Valid values: 7200 to 31536000. Unit: seconds.

Default value:

- If not specified, the default value is 2,592,000 seconds (30 days) for NativeApp and ServerApp applications.

- If not specified, the default value is 7,776,000 seconds (90 days) for WebApp applications
parameters.help_zh:
刷新令牌有效期。

取值范围：7200~31536000。单位：秒。

默认值：

- 对于NativeApp和ServerApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为2592000秒（即30天）。
- 对于WebApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为7776000秒（即90天）
parameters.name: refresh_token_validity

parameters.help_en:
The scope of application permissions.

For more information about the application permission scope, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html operation to obtain the scopes that are supported by different application types.

To specify multiple permissions, separate them with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
应用权限范围。

关于应用权限范围的取值和描述，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html获取不同应用类型支持的应用权限范围。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: predefined_scopes

parameters.help_en:
The required permission.

You can specify one or more permissions for the `RequiredScopes` parameter. When a user grants permissions to the application, the scopes specified in this parameter are pre-selected and cannot be deselected.

To enter multiple scopes, separate them with semicolons (;).

> Any scope specified here must also be included in `PredefinedScopes`. Otherwise, the scope will not be set as required
parameters.help_zh:
必选的应用权限范围。

您可以将`RequiredScopes`中设置的一个或多个范围设为必选，设为必选后，当用户进行应用授权时，必选范围默认选中且不可取消。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔。

> 如果您设置的`RequiredScopes`项不在`PredefinedScopes`的范围内，则该项必选范围不生效
parameters.name: required_scopes

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the application can be installed by other Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

- true: If not specified, the default value is true for NativeApp and ServerApp applications.

- false: If not specified, the default value is false for WebApp applications
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许被其他账号安装。取值：

- true：对于NativeApp和ServerApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为true。
- false：对于WebApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为false
parameters.name: is_multi_tenant

parameters.help_en:
The application name.

It can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
应用名称。

最大长度为64 个字符，允许输入英文字母、数字、英文句点（.）、下划线（_）或中划线（-）
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The OAuth protocol version of the application. Valid values:

- `2.0`: OAuth 2.0

- `2.1`: OAuth 2.1

Default value: `2.0`
parameters.help_zh:
应用的OAuth协议版本。取值：
+ `2.0`：表示为OAuth 2.0协议。
+ `2.1`：表示为OAuth 2.1协议。

默认值：`2.0`
parameters.name: protocol_version
